description: GENERATED from spectral-config/config/domains.config.ts — do not hand-edit. Regenerate with `npm run generate:all` in spectral-config/.

payment_required.meaning: no usable payment presented; see challenge

payment_id_fingerprint_conflict.meaning: paymentId already bound to a different request

payment_id_channel_mismatch.meaning: header paymentId disagrees with extension-carried identifier

call_in_progress.meaning: a matching request is executing; retry with the same paymentId

entitlement_expired.meaning: retry entitlement lapsed; issue a new paymentId

settlement_pending_review.meaning: settlement outcome unresolved; quarantined for operator review

capability_unavailable.meaning: adapter failed repeatedly; not a payment fault

tile_not_found.meaning: unknown cid in this pack (content-address silence)

tile_withdrawn.meaning: tile withdrawn per the signed status list

status_list_stale.meaning: revocation status unknown past next_update; failing closed

body_too_large.meaning: request body exceeds the declared cap

tls_required.meaning: paid route requires https; failing closed

mainnet_gate_unmet.meaning: mainnet requires a valid signed evidence gate
